prompt: Create an original 90 second deep instrumental house instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: warm synth chords, four-on-floor drums, sub bass. Style: consistent dance groove, small filter movement, no large drop. Tempo approximately 126 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: An atmospheric electronic track featuring layered synthesizers, a steady electronic drum beat, and a driving synth bass. It has a dreamy and slightly melancholic yet uplifting feel.
description.zh: 一首氛围感十足的电子乐曲，以多层合成器、稳定的电子鼓点和驱动性的合成器贝斯为特色。它带有一种梦幻、略带忧郁但又充满希望的感觉。
